Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Overview The aim is to capture an opponents castle by moving onto it (The castle itself cannot move) Turn On your turn You have 3 options: 1) Rotate a piece 2) Move a piece 3) Move then Rotate a piece Pieces All pieces (except the castle) are essentially identical, the icon which is currently the right way round (aka at the top from your perspective) is the active type, these are split into: Warrior - Moves 1 square Left/Right, Forward, or Diagonal Left/Right forward (5 options) Blade - Moves up to 2 squares forward Catapult - Moves up to 3 squares diagonally forward Shield - The only type which can move backwards, 2 squares straight back or 1 square diagonal back Board Game Arena would like to thank Unicopli Giochi for making it possible to have this game here. 1035 evogamenoname العربية беларуская мова български език Brezhoneg Català čeština Dansk Deutsch Ελληνικά English Español Eesti keel فارسی Suomi Français Galego עברית Hrvatski Magyar Italiano Bahasa Indonesia 日本語 한국어 Lietuvių Latviešu Bahasa Malaysia Nederlands Norsk Polski Português Română Русский язык Slovenčina Slovenščina Српски Svenska ไทย Türkçe Українська мова Tiếng Việt 中文 (漢) 中文 (汉) Application loading... ... {DISPLAY_IN_OTHER_LANG} {LANG_REDIRECT_CODE} boardgamearena.com Top Help What is Board Game Arena?
